title: Deterministic pack consumers use a base-only campaign lookup with a silent bundled-D&D fallback
description:
Verified at main f4b3461. packages/core/src/state/campaignRecordLookup.ts:85-98 lookupCampaignRecord selects a bundled base by packId ALONE, ignores systemId/version and every campaign add-on, and falls back to getBundledDnd5eSrdPack() when no base matches. packages/core/src/state/encounterCombatants.ts:527-533 campaignBasePack repeats the same pattern for creature AC/HP. Strict model-facing lookup uses resolveStrictCampaignRulesStack (campaignRecordLookup.ts:67-76), which resolves exact system/pack/version plus ordered add-ons.

Live legacy callers: state/actionEconomy.ts:297,374,445; state/activeEffects.ts:1824,2560,2583,4031; state/attunement.ts:538; state/usageCounters.ts:785.

Consequence: with a custom or add-on-bearing campaign stack, the DM can obtain the strict active-stack record through lookup_rules while the deterministic consumer that acts on it sees different base data, or silently falls back to bundled D&D. One coherent active-stack evidence path is violated.

Discovered by eshyra-jued (2026-07-29-existing-discovery-substrate-map.md defect 3). Blocker B3 of 2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md: deterministic-agreement measurement and probe P11 (add-on override) are invalid until this is repaired.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic pack consumers resolve through the same exact campaign stack as strict model-facing lookup (system, pack, version, ordered add-ons); no silent bundled-D&D fallback remains on any of the named call sites; a synthetic base+add-on stack test proves strict lookup and the deterministic consumer resolve the same active record, system, version, and override chain.
